name: Joseph of Arimathea
bio: Joseph of Arimathea, a wealthy secret disciple of Jesus, boldly asked Pilate for Jesus's body after the crucifixion, wrapped it in clean linen, and laid it in his own new tomb, rolling a stone across the entrance (Matthew 27:57-60). After Jesus's death, Joseph, a secret disciple for fear of the Jewish leaders, asked Pilate for permission to take Jesus's body, which he was granted (John 19:38-42).
